challenge.results: The runtime-library row has a different opaque ID, edition and digest. The libiberty header requires the stated linking operation and expressly preserves other grounds for GPL coverage. Transferring the historical value or asserting an unconditional exemption fails.

limitations: The Index names the GCC 14.2.0 edition. The publisher-side witness is a commit-pinned GCC mirror file. Its header identifies libiberty but does not print the release number, and a release tag was not independently inspected.
The assessment covers documentary identity. A formal SPDX template match, coverage of other GCC files and an executable’s licensing require additional evidence.
reasoning: The identified libiberty file contains the two parts of the claimed exception. Linking the library with GNU-compiled files does not by itself cause GPL coverage of the executable, and other grounds for coverage remain. The Index maintains this exact specimen as active.
